segments.text: O Lord which doeſt teache vs, that all our doinges without charitie are nothing worthe: ſende thy holy goſte and powre into oure heartes that moſte excellent gyfte of charitie, the very bonde of peace and all vertues, without the whiche, whoſoeuer lyueth is counted dead before thee: Graunt this, for thy onely ſonne Ieſus Chriſtes ſake.
